messages:
ana: Heads-up design check: proposing a compact 'schema lane' in Run History for function calls. Goal: make structured outputs scannable while keeping keyboard + SR flows clean. Attached mini-mock. carlos: Nice. Quick UX asks: collapsed line should show a one-line summary + status. Avoid 'Output' label; prefer 'Result' or 'Tool result'. mei: Accessibility: collapse toggle must be a native \n getProfile() · structured · 120ms\n \n\n
\n``` jordyn: :thumbsup: I'll prepare header copy variants (short/medium) and check German/JA truncation. carlos: Tests: add keyboard e2e for lane focus order and ARIA-expanded state, plus an SR smoke test for the finalization announcement. mei: Performance: collapse long arrays by default with a "Show more" control reachable by keyboard. Ensure tree semantics (role=tree/treeitem) for drill nodes. ana: (again, meant @ana) I'll push updated frames and label the ARIA notes. Ping here for a round 2 review. a11y-bot: Checklist: native button with aria-expanded, aria-controls, role=region + aria-labelledby, aria-live finalization only, keyboard focus tests, i18n length checks, copy-announcement.
